runtime_encoding: lossless 58-bit cache-line number plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit

neural_action_decoder.request_count: deterministic raw hurdle decision plus rounded learned conditional excess mean
neural_action_decoder.targets: four-component signed-log direct-delta mixture ordered by component peak density, then hard-quantized with nonzero/distinct legality
neural_action_decoder.fill: separate unweighted two-class posterior with stateless keyed hard categorical draw
neural_action_decoder.feedback: actual hard emitted delta and actual hard fill one-hot; straight-through only during training

stochastic_decoding: stateless SHA-256 keyed fill draw only; count and delta are deterministic
event_key_definition: zero-based role-local decision index plus source-visible cache-line number
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP request count, direct target, and fill class as supervision only; teacher count schedules loss ranks but is not an inference rollout

lstm.architecture: one compact chronological LSTM plus deterministic hurdle/excess count, factorized four-component delta mixture, and separate rare-fill head
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT over the complete demand/fill event sequence; hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.action_training: teacher-count-scheduled losses with the model's own hard delta/fill action fed to the next rank through straight-through feedback
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; guard is causal warm-up/audit only and evaluation demand callbacks produce replay

eviction_feedback_role: raw chronological source-visible input event only; no private SPP state and no separate eviction prediction target

v17_diagnosis.duplicate_failure: soft delta expectation feedback made later ranks collapse to the same materialized target
v17_diagnosis.trajectory_failure: training fed soft delta/fill distributions while replay executed hard delta/fill actions
v17_diagnosis.fill_failure: predicted L2 fraction exceeded the approximately two-percent teacher fraction and converted many wrong actions into harmful L2 placements
v17_diagnosis.v18_change: deterministic count, one shared hard legal action selector, straight-through hard feedback, and direct keyed fill posterior without an address-confidence multiplier

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
